newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PX50 PLUNGES AGAIN AT FIXING.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PX50 PLUNGES AGAIN AT FIXING.

text.p: Czech shares fell sharply at Thursday's fixing while the Czech crown was hit by its most turbulent morning yet on the foreign exchange markets.
Apart from blue chip power utility CEZ, which fell 26 crowns to 869, most of the downward pressure came from issues in the broader market.
Dealers say continued uncertainty in the foreign exchange markets over the fate of the beleagured Czech crown is the decisive issue determining movevments on the PX50.
